name: Haronar
description: The Kav pilot who remains aboard the ship, whose radio fades into a mumbled prayer.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar's squad flies out to investigate a drifted fragment of Kavaron possibly a memorial vault, passing the glowing ruin of their world.
timeline.quote: Here, in this incandescent catastrophe, is the reason for all her missions.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: They find a twenty-kilometer white structure unlike any memorial vault, and the scope cannot image it.
timeline.quote: The ship slows and the white edge of a structure emerges from the darkness.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Haronar lands on the structure and the squad drills through the wall, then cuts into the next chamber.
timeline.quote: The wall, though, doesn't crumble beneath Rakoro's blade. It peels back and curls up like skin.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The artifact vanishes from the room and the radio from Haronar degrades.
timeline.quote: But it's clearly gone, not even a mark where the pedestal was.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar reaches the artifact and loses contact with Haronar, who is praying.
timeline.quote: it's the desperate mumblings of a prayer.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.
